animations.name: sonner-fade-in
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
animations.description: Toast notification entrance animation with opacity fade and scale up.

animations.name: sonner-fade-out
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-out { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } }
animations.description: Toast notification exit animation with opacity fade and scale down.

animations.name: sonner-spin
animations.description: Loading spinner animation for toast loading states.

animations.name: swipe-out
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out { 0% { transform: translateY(calc(var(--lift) * var(--offset) + var(--swipe-amount))); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(calc(var(--lift) * var(--offset) + var(--swipe-amount) + var(--lift) * -100%)); opacity: 0; } }

animations.name: spin
animations.description: Continuous rotation animation for loading spinners in consent overlay.

animations.name: fides-skeleton-loading
animations.description: Skeleton loading shimmer effect for privacy consent UI.

animations.name: button-transition
animations.description: Standard button state transition applied to all button components.

animations.name: card-hover-scale
animations.description: Card image scale transform on hover, scales to 1.02.

animations.name: arrow-slide
animations.description: Arrow icon slide animation on link hover, JS-driven via animate-arrow-slide class.

animations.name: ticker-scroll
animations.description: Horizontal marquee scrolling for metrics ticker and testimonial carousel, JS-driven via transform: translateX updates.

animations.name: number-flow
animations.description: Animated number counter for live metrics display, JS-driven number-flow-react component.

insights: The design system uses a yellow/gold ('solar') primary CTA color against white backgrounds for high contrast, with gray secondary buttons for visual hierarchy.
Motion is heavily JS-driven (number counters, marquee tickers, scroll-linked animations) rather than CSS keyframes, indicating a React/Next.js animation approach.
Button border-radius is consistently rounded-md (6px) across the system with rounded-full reserved for video play buttons and icon badges, creating a modern but not overly rounded aesthetic.
